name: Capital Airlines
blurb: A proudly all-Boeing American carrier connecting national and state capitals from its Washington Dulles hub.

about: Capital Airlines is a medium-cost United States carrier founded in Washington, D.C., on 4 July 1945 for one purpose: connecting travellers from capital to capital, whether that means a national capital or a state capital.
Based at Washington Dulles International Airport, Capital is proudly Boeing. Fears of bankruptcy led it to join the Pacific Sunset Group in 2001, securing its place within the wider group.
network: Capital's present network also includes several exceptions to its capital-city focus: New York via JFK, Newark and LaGuardia; Los Angeles; Long Beach; and Tampa.
